title: Send a receipt when an invoice is paid
summary: When an invoice of yours is paid in full, send the customer a thank-you receipt by SMS and email with the link to their paid invoice, and tell you.
description: Starts the moment one of your invoices is paid in full. The customer gets one thank-you by SMS, and by email when you have their address, with the invoice's number and its link, which now shows it paid; you are told too. It starts once for each invoice paid, so nobody is thanked twice. An invoice is paid only when the payments counted towards it cover it, never by the workflow.

params.name: tell_me
params.title: Tell me too
params.description: Also tell you each time an invoice is paid.

definition.name: Thank customers for paid invoices
definition.description: Sends the customer whose invoice was just paid one thank-you with its link, and tells the owner.

input.text: Thank you: we have received your payment for invoice {number}. See it, marked paid: {link}
input.subject: =trigger.body.number + ' is paid: thank you'

steps.name: Note the thank-you that could not go

input.title: Invoice paid
input.message: ='Invoice ' + trigger.body.number + ' (' + trigger.body.amount + ') is paid in full.'
